checks.name: paper_eligibility
checks.detail: Each research method maps to a 2023+ nonlearning paper; four named ECC2024 variants share one paper; fixed-time is separate.

checks.name: no_rl_or_training
checks.detail: No RL branch is extracted from a hybrid paper in the current registry.

checks.name: transition_policy_documented
checks.detail: Each method must record its transition policy. Stored all-red phases and optional added clearance are distinct; documentation is not a real-world calibration certificate.

dataset_schema.name: run_id
dataset_schema.description: One simulation run; four probes belong to the same run

dataset_schema.name: scenario
dataset_schema.description: Shared demand and seed input configuration

dataset_schema.name: probe_id
dataset_schema.description: Tracked vehicle identifier

dataset_schema.name: method
dataset_schema.description: Controller, not a learned feature

dataset_schema.name: is_reference
dataset_schema.description: True for the extra shared fixed-time baseline

dataset_schema.name: backend
dataset_schema.description: Simulator API/backend

dataset_schema.name: engine_version
dataset_schema.description: Actual simulator version reported by the running backend

dataset_schema.name: simulation_step_s
dataset_schema.description: Numerical simulation step length in seconds

dataset_schema.name: stop_reason
dataset_schema.description: All tracked probes arrived, or simulation guard reached

dataset_schema.name: phase_switches
dataset_schema.description: Controller switches across the network up to stop; unequal windows

dataset_schema.name: controller_exercised
dataset_schema.description: False for QD runs that only used the initial/fallback plan

dataset_schema.name: demand_scale
dataset_schema.description: Demand multiplier; assumed, not observed traffic

dataset_schema.name: seed
dataset_schema.description: Paired random seed; not a traffic measurement

dataset_schema.name: vehicle_type
dataset_schema.description: Probe class

dataset_schema.name: vehicle_movement_model
dataset_schema.description: Recorded movement model; unspecified for legacy runs

dataset_schema.name: lane_change_model
dataset_schema.description: Recorded SUMO lane-changing model

dataset_schema.name: route_variant
dataset_schema.description: Fixed center/outer probe path

dataset_schema.name: corridor_vph_per_direction
dataset_schema.description: Explicitly assigned corridor background vehicles/hour/direction

dataset_schema.name: corridor_requested_vph_forward
dataset_schema.description: Explicitly assigned corridor background vehicles/hour towards Truong Chinh

dataset_schema.name: corridor_requested_vph_reverse
dataset_schema.description: Explicitly assigned corridor background vehicles/hour in the opposite direction

dataset_schema.name: map_requested_vph
dataset_schema.description: Requested background vehicles/hour, whole map

dataset_schema.name: corridor_related_requested_vph
dataset_schema.description: Requested journeys/hour using any Cong Hoa segment; includes side-road entry and exit journeys

dataset_schema.name: corridor_related_generated_vehicles
dataset_schema.description: Generated ordinary journeys using any Cong Hoa segment during the demand window

dataset_schema.name: map_generated_vehicles
dataset_schema.description: Generated background vehicles during demand window; not actually inserted

dataset_schema.name: map_generation_ratio
dataset_schema.description: Generated / requested background vehicles during demand window; routing losses, not completion rate

dataset_schema.name: demand_duration_s
dataset_schema.description: Demand generation window (s)

dataset_schema.name: probe_requested_depart_s
dataset_schema.description: Scheduled probe departure (s)

dataset_schema.name: motorcycle_share
dataset_schema.description: Requested corridor motorcycle proportion

dataset_schema.name: car_share
dataset_schema.description: Requested corridor passenger-car proportion

dataset_schema.name: truck_share
dataset_schema.description: Requested corridor truck proportion

dataset_schema.name: bus_share
dataset_schema.description: Requested corridor bus proportion

dataset_schema.name: travel_time_s
dataset_schema.description: Actual insertion to arrival; excludes departure delay

dataset_schema.name: waiting_time_s
dataset_schema.description: Waiting within trip, already part of travel time

dataset_schema.name: depart_delay_s
dataset_schema.description: Delay before insertion; separate from travel time

dataset_schema.name: route_length_m
dataset_schema.description: Distance actually traveled from SUMO tripinfo (m)

dataset_schema.name: mean_speed_kmh
dataset_schema.description: Actual route length / trip duration × 3.6

dataset_schema.name: time_loss_s
dataset_schema.description: SUMO timeLoss, not equal to waitingTime

dataset_schema.name: waiting_count
dataset_schema.description: SUMO waitingCount

dataset_schema.name: collisions
dataset_schema.description: Whole-run collision count up to stop

dataset_schema.name: teleports
dataset_schema.description: Whole-run teleport count up to stop

dataset_schema.name: completed
dataset_schema.description: Probe arrival recorded

dataset_schema.name: censored
dataset_schema.description: Probe has no recorded arrival at experiment stop

dataset_schema.name: departed
dataset_schema.description: Probe was actually inserted into the network

dataset_schema.name: valid_for_comparison
dataset_schema.description: Eligibility under the saved comparison policy; all_four_arrived permits runs with flagged events

dataset_schema.name: clean_run
dataset_schema.description: Original strict check including zero whole-run collisions and teleports

dataset_schema.name: all_four_arrived

dataset_schema.description: Tracked vehicle named in a teleport warning; blank if simulator log is unavailable

dataset_schema.name: probe_collision
dataset_schema.description: Tracked vehicle named in a collision warning; blank if simulator log is unavailable

dataset_schema.name: paired_valid
dataset_schema.description: Valid probe and fixed-time reference with matching input hashes

dataset_schema.name: improvement_vs_fixed_percent
dataset_schema.description: Paired travel-time reduction; positive is faster

dataset_schema.name: network_sha256
dataset_schema.description: Network content version

dataset_schema.name: input_sha256
dataset_schema.description: Canonical digest of all frozen simulation input hashes

dataset_schema.name: actual_end_s
dataset_schema.description: Actual observation horizon for this method

dataset_schema.name: inserted_network_vehicles
dataset_schema.description: Vehicles actually inserted by run stop

dataset_schema.name: mean_network_speed_mps
dataset_schema.description: Network snapshot speed at stop; observation horizons may differ

dataset_schema.name: halted_network_vehicles
dataset_schema.description: Vehicles halting at experiment stop

dataset_schema.name: arrived_network_vehicles
dataset_schema.description: Vehicles arrived by run stop; windows differ, do not rank raw totals

dataset_schema.name: running_network_vehicles
dataset_schema.description: Vehicles still running when experiment stops

dataset_schema.name: pending_network_vehicles
dataset_schema.description: Vehicles awaiting insertion when experiment stops
